ezekiel.2.p1.b1.text: Son of man … stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.

ezekiel.2.p1.b2.text: And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet

ezekiel.2.p1.b3.text: Son of man … I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. … And whether they listen or refuse to listen … they will know that a prophet has been among them.

ezekiel.2.p1.b4.text: son of man … Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. … or dismayed by their presence

ezekiel.2.p1.b5.text: listen to what I tell you. … Open your mouth and eat what I give you.

ezekiel.2.p1.b6.text: which He unrolled before me. And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
